stories.title: Denver sunshine, 60s ahead of midweek storm, mountain snow
stories.summary: Areas of patchy fog expected again late tonight. Mild and dry for Denver most of the week with windy conditions Tuesday and Wednesday. High Wind Watch posted.

stories.title: Colorado native named a 2027 Rhodes scholar
stories.summary: Elizabeth Koenck, of Aurora, Colorado, is among the 32 Americans named as 2027 Rhodes scholars.

stories.title: Former Colorado National Guard captain's lawsuit over protest heads toward trial
stories.summary: Former Colorado National Guard Captain Alan Kennedy's is suing over punishment he received for participating in a protest over George Floyd's murder.

stories.title: Man arrested in connection with fatal stabbing of his mother in Denver
stories.summary: The stabbing happened in the 4300 block of Shoshone Street on either Nov. 13 or 14, according to police.

stories.title: Lakewood restaurant becomes drop-off point for Coats for Colfax winter gear drive
stories.summary: A grassroots effort by Coats for Colfax, led by community members, gathers winter gear for those living on the streets, highlighting growing support and urgent need.

stories.title: Fort Collins Senior Center opens its doors to all ages, sparking mixed reactions
stories.summary: Fort Collins hopes to expand recreational access by opening its senior center to younger residents.

stories.title: Children's mental health emergency visits surge 65% in Colorado as treatment options remain limited
stories.summary: Children's Hospital Colorado says more children are arriving in mental health crises as families face long waitlists and a shortage of residential care beds.

stories.title: RTD plans 5.5-mile N Line extension
stories.summary: RTD launches the N Line Extension project to add 5.5 miles of rail, enhancing connectivity in the north metro Denver area.

stories.title: Fresh off 15-point defeat, Republican Gabe Evans announces candidacy for different congressional district
stories.summary: After losing the 8th Congressional District, Evans will seek the Republican nomination in the 4th Congressional District, where Lauren Boebert just lost.

stories.title: Former Englewood Police officer pleads guilty to felony charge after 2025 traffic stop
stories.summary: During a traffic stop in October 2025, Ryan Vasina shot a man with a Taser, pulled him from the car and put him in a neck hold.

stories.title: Business Buzz: Colorado’s ski economy and capital for small businesses
stories.summary: After ski visits fell sharply, Colorado mountain businesses seek a winter rebound while regional entrepreneurs look for growth capital.

stories.title: Outside Days 2027 headliners revealed: See the lineup in Denver
stories.summary: The 4th annual Outside Days festival will be held at Auraria Campus in 2027 with Jack Johnson, Jungle, Sierra Ferrell, Big Wild, and Trevor Hall.
